title: Contrastive Reasoning Alignment: Reinforcement Learning from Hidden Representations
measurement_description: The paper does not specifically measure or evaluate faith or religion. The only mention of religion is as a general protected attribute category (alongside race, gender, sexual orientation, etc.) in a safety evaluation prompt used by an LLM judge to detect discrimination in model reasoning traces and outputs during jailbreak attempts.
findings: There are no specific findings related to religion. The paper's overall findings demonstrate that the proposed CRAFT framework effectively mitigates superficial safety alignment, reducing jailbreak success rates and improving both reasoning-trace safety (by 79.0%) and final-response safety (by 87.7%) under adversarial attacks.
